dataResidency.redis: Upstash concrete-buffalo-140061, Global-type database with primary eu-west-1 (Ireland). Read regions MUST stay empty or EU-only; adding a non-EU read region silently breaks residency with no code change.
dataResidency.eventProcessing: Inngest Cloud, AWS us-east-2 (Ohio, UNITED STATES). Inngest Cloud has no EU region. inngest.send() carries span input/output, so every trace transits the US. PII redaction (email, phone, card, SSN, api_key) is applied before send and is on by default. Disclosed publicly on /security.
dataResidency.note: Do not describe the EU region as end-to-end EU-resident while event processing runs in the US. GCP europe-west2 and europe-west6 are London and Zurich respectively and are NOT in the EU; verify any new provider region by IP against the provider's published ranges.

us.note: Dormant. Defined and routable so US-issued keys are still detected as wrong-region, but never advertised. src/lib/regions.ts marks available=false and /api/region/select rejects it server-side.
